hotspots.title: Milei-Villarruel rift deepens over Tedeum snub
hotspots.blurb: The exclusion of Vice President Victoria Villarruel from Argentina's Tedeum ceremony by President Javier Milei's team has escalated internal tensions within La Libertad Avanza. Villarruel's public response and the broader fallout highlight a significant power struggle.
hotspots.affect: This commands disproportionate attention due to the high-profile nature of the rift, the moral and political stakes involved, and the polarized framing of loyalty and betrayal within the ruling coalition.

hotspots.affect: The elections are charged due to their perceived role as a referendum on Meloni’s leadership, the intense framing of political survival, and the polarized reactions from different political factions.

hotspots.affect: The AfD's rise commands attention due to the alarmist framing of its potential to disrupt democratic norms, the polarized reactions from mainstream parties, and the moral panic over far-right governance.

hotspots.title: Vox’s rise in working-class strongholds

hotspots.affect: Vox's rise is charged due to its implications for Spain's political future, the moral panic over immigration, and the polarized framing of national identity and economic grievances.
